title: Show session cost in WebApp
summary: CodeAssistant moves to LLMLib 0.3.0 and CopilotLib 0.7.0, whose `AskStreamingAsync` streams typed items: text chunks plus usage updates with the response and session cost in dollars. In the TUI and planner, text handling moves to the new text items. The planner also forwards usage through a new `IPlanningInteraction.OnUsage` callback. In the web app, chat usage is sent as a new usage chunk on the `SendMessage` stream and planning usage as a `PlanUsage` hub event. The Chat and Plan views show "Session cost: $X.XXXX", updated live and reset when a new chat or plan starts. A small test project covers the server-side mapping, and the README is updated.
findings: CodeAssistant.Lib references `Neph.GenericLibs.Net.LLMLib` 0.2.0. CodeAssistant.WebApp and CodeAssistant.TUI reference `Neph.GenericLibs.Net.CopilotLib` 0.6.0. The packages restore from D:\dev\GenericLibs.Net\local-nuget-feed (nuget.config).
Three callers of `AskStreamingAsync` must handle the typed stream: TUI `Program.StreamReplyAsync`, WebApp `ChatConversation.ProduceAsync` and Lib `FeaturePlanner.AskAsync`.
Chat uses the SignalR streaming method `AssistantHub.SendMessage`, which returns `IAsyncEnumerable<ChatChunk>`. `ChatChunkKind` is serialized in camelCase by `JsonStringEnumConverter`.
`PlanningRun` (the only `IPlanningInteraction` implementer) forwards callbacks as ordered hub events through `Send(method, args)`. PlanView registers handlers in a single `useEffect` list.
In ChatView the toolbar holds Mode, ModelPicker and "New chat". In PlanView the toolbar is only rendered while running, and the phase stepper is shown whenever status != idle.
The repository has no test projects. CodeAssistant.Lib.csproj already declares InternalsVisibleTo for CodeAssistant.Lib.Tests.
ClientApp is React 19 with Vite and TypeScript. It has no test runner; `npm run build` type-checks it (`tsc`).

phases.name: Upgrade libraries and adapt callers
phases.goal: Consume LLMLib 0.3.0 and CopilotLib 0.7.0 and adapt every `AskStreamingAsync` caller to the typed stream.

tasks.title: Bump GenericLibs package references
tasks.description:
Prerequisite: the GenericLibs.Net plan task T3.2 must have packed LLMLib 0.3.0 and CopilotLib 0.7.0 into D:\dev\GenericLibs.Net\local-nuget-feed.

Then update the package references:
- CodeAssistant.Lib.csproj: `Neph.GenericLibs.Net.LLMLib` to 0.3.0.
- CodeAssistant.WebApp.csproj and CodeAssistant.TUI.csproj: `Neph.GenericLibs.Net.CopilotLib` to 0.7.0.

Run `dotnet restore CodeAssistant.slnx`.

tasks.title: Adapt TUI to typed stream
tasks.description:
In `Program.StreamReplyAsync`, iterate `IAsyncEnumerable<LLMStreamItem>`:
- For `LLMTextChunk text`, append `text.Text` to `pending` under the existing lock.
- Ignore `LLMUsageUpdate`, since the user chose not to show cost in the TUI.

Add `using LLMLib.DTO;`. All other TUI behaviour stays unchanged.

tasks.title: Forward planner usage through IPlanningInteraction
tasks.description:
1. IPlanningInteraction.cs: add `void OnUsage(decimal responseCost, decimal sessionCost);` with the doc "The LLM session reported usage: cost of the current turn so far and of the whole planning session, in US dollars (AI credits / 100)."
2. FeaturePlanner.cs: add an `IPlanningInteraction interaction` parameter to `AwaitCompletionAsync` and `AskAsync`, and pass it from `PlanAsync` (Design and Refinement calls) and from `RunPhaseAsync`.
3. In `AskAsync`, switch on each item:
   - `LLMTextChunk t`: `buffer.Append(t.Text)`.
   - `LLMUsageUpdate u`: `interaction.OnUsage(u.ResponseCost, u.SessionCost)`.
   - Keep the final `buffer.Flush()`.

Add `using LLMLib.DTO;`.

phases.name: WebApp server: send cost to clients
phases.goal: Send cost updates from the server to the browser for both chat and planning.

tasks.title: Add Usage chunk kind
tasks.description:
In Models/HubModels.cs:
- Add `Usage` to `ChatChunkKind`.
- Extend `ChatChunk` to `ChatChunk(ChatChunkKind Kind, string Text, string? ToolName = null, decimal? ResponseCost = null, decimal? SessionCost = null)`.
- Update the XML summary: a usage chunk has empty `Text` and carries the costs in US dollars.

tasks.title: Map usage updates in ChatConversation
tasks.description:
In `ChatConversation.ProduceAsync`, iterate the typed stream and map each item:
- `LLMTextChunk t` becomes `new ChatChunk(ChatChunkKind.Text, t.Text)`.
- `LLMUsageUpdate u` becomes `new ChatChunk(ChatChunkKind.Usage, string.Empty, null, u.ResponseCost, u.SessionCost)`.

Write them to the channel in the order received. Add `using LLMLib.DTO;`.

tasks.title: Emit PlanUsage hub event
tasks.description:
Implement `public void OnUsage(decimal responseCost, decimal sessionCost) => Send("PlanUsage", responseCost, sessionCost);` in `PlanningRun`.

In AssistantHub.cs, update the class summary to mention the PlanUsage event and the usage chat chunks.

phases.name: WebApp client: show session cost
phases.goal: Display the live session cost in the Chat and Plan views.

tasks.title: Client types and SessionCost component
tasks.description: 1. types.ts: change `ChatChunk.kind` to `'text' | 'tool' | 'usage'` and add the optional fields `responseCost?: number | null` and `sessionCost?: number | null`. 2. Create components/SessionCost.tsx exporting `SessionCost({ cost }: { cost: number })`. It renders `Session cost: ${'$'}{cost.toFixed(4)}`. 3. index.css: add a `.session-cost` rule using the existing muted text colour, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, `white-space: nowrap` and `margin-left: auto`, so it sits at the right of toolbars.

tasks.title: Show session cost in ChatView
tasks.description:
In ChatView.tsx:
- Add `const [sessionCost, setSessionCost] = useState<number | null>(null)`.
- After `StartChat` succeeds, `setSessionCost(0)`.
- In the stream's `next` handler, handle `chunk.kind === 'usage'` by calling `setSessionCost(chunk.sessionCost ?? 0)`. Don't append an entry. Tool and text chunks stay as before.
- In `newChat()`, `setSessionCost(null)`.
- Render `{sessionCost !== null && <SessionCost cost={sessionCost} />}` at the end of the toolbar.

tasks.title: Show session cost in PlanView
tasks.description:
In PlanView.tsx:
- Add `const [sessionCost, setSessionCost] = useState(0)`.
- Add the handler `['PlanUsage', (_responseCost: number, cost: number) => setSessionCost(cost)]` to the handlers list.
- Call `setSessionCost(0)` in `start()`.
- Render `<SessionCost cost={sessionCost} />` whenever `status !== 'idle'`, in a row with the phase stepper (wrap `<ol className="phases">` and the cost in a flex container, with CSS in index.css if needed). This keeps it visible after completion, failure or cancellation.

relevantFiles.purpose: Handles typed items and forwards usage.
Usage chunk kind and cost fields.
Maps typed items to chat chunks.
Local feed from which the new library versions are restored.

decisions: Session cost is shown in both the Chat and Plan views and updated on every usage event (the user chose this). Format: "Session cost: $" followed by the amount with 4 decimals.

Chat cost travels in the existing `SendMessage` stream, as a new kind `ChatChunkKind.Usage` with nullable `ResponseCost` and `SessionCost` fields. Its order relative to the text is kept and no new hub method is needed.

Planning cost travels through a new `IPlanningInteraction.OnUsage(responseCost, sessionCost)` callback, which `PlanningRun` forwards as a `PlanUsage` hub event, consistent with PlanPhase, PlanMessage and PlanTool.
The TUI is only adapted to the typed stream and shows no cost (the user chose this).
The web app creates new sessions only, so each displayed cost starts at $0 when a chat or plan starts.
A new CodeAssistant.WebApp.Tests xUnit project covers the server-side mapping. The UI is verified manually, because the ClientApp has no test tooling.
outOfScope: Per-message cost badges, cost history, and persisting costs across app restarts.
The GenericLibs.Net library changes themselves, which are covered by the GenericLibs.Net plan.
furtherConsiderations: Showing the cost of the last response (`responseCost`) next to each assistant message would be a small extension, since the data is already sent.
A planning session runs many turns. A per-phase cost breakdown could be added later if useful.
If the SDK only delivers usage after the turn ends, the cost updates once per turn rather than during the stream. This depends on the GenericLibs.Net task T2.1/T2.2.
